query:
UPDATE feeds
        SET
            title = COALESCE($1, title),
            description = COALESCE($2, description),
            is_public = COALESCE($3, is_public),
            full_text = CASE WHEN COALESCE($3, is_public) THEN false
                             ELSE COALESCE($5, full_text) END
        WHERE id = $4
